Oldest to newest. Translations up to page 99 were done by myself. The rest are from the artist.

Edit 05/21/2026: I was planning to wait until the end of the month to do a proper update, but with Fantia tightening its censorship rules, I figured I’d do a preliminary update now to serve as a PSA.

Currently, the only works that are scheduled to be affected are:
https://fantia.jp/posts/1681535
https://fantia.jp/posts/2466257
https://fantia.jp/posts/2653015
https://fantia.jp/posts/3196964
https://fantia.jp/posts/3829371

Fortunately, the first four are already in this gallery, and the fifth one is available to buy here (for now, at least):
https://xfolio.jp/portfolio/tomoshib/shop/63708

Still, we never know what might happen in the future, so if you have any work that isn’t already in the gallery and you’re willing to share it for completion/preservation sake, let me know.

Here are the missing months to make things easier:
July 2024: https://fantia.jp/posts/2905381
August 2024: https://fantia.jp/posts/2942157
November 2024: https://fantia.jp/posts/3128307
January 2025: https://fantia.jp/posts/3251796
June 2025: https://fantia.jp/posts/3504786
And everything past that, except September/October 2025 and this month, which I have a subscription for (and hopefully the content won't be affected).

Also, I said in the last update that I would gatekeep the Japanese/no-text versions out of spite, but I’m willing to ease up on that if we get the missing content (at least the ones that were posted in Chinese only).

And if anyone has the content that was deleted from Pixiv years ago, that would be appreciated as well.

Edit 05/31/2025: It kinda bothered me that the last update cut off at the first part of a two-part work, so here we are.
That said, I only got the content that seemed most appealing to me this time, so the rest is missing.
Also, I won’t be sharing the Japanese/no-text versions until others start doing the same...

Edit 06/01/2024: I was already on the fence about keeping my subscription going, but it looks like Fantia made the decision for me by suspending Visa/Mastercard payments. Well, it was a good ride. So this is probably the last update new content-wise. While I was at it, I also went back to my own translations to improve them if needed.
